name: hdr_histogram
abstract: Bounded-error latency percentiles using HDR histograms
description: Stores a serialized HdrHistogram as a first-class PostgreSQL type, with aggregates and scalar functions to build, merge and query bounded-error percentiles (p50 / p99 / p99.9) with lossless merge.
